rights.referenceBoundary: Publisher metadata includes retrieval/generation references. Those names/paths are not separate rights grants. No referenced corpus, texture, image, video, package or upstream application JavaScript is imported.

renderer.initialFailureResolution: A first trial time-scaling/literal-resolution adapter produced numerical GPU differences. It was rejected, replaced with direct uniform aliases, and all16 compiled candidates were rendered again with zero RGBA error. Historical diagnostics are explicitly superseded and carry no stale current PNG paths.

deduplication.limitations: Coverage is the retained123 old GLSL originals and54 new primary GLSL sources plus this54-file pinned source inventory. Not a proof against every shader on the internet. Basic families excluded conservatively even below numeric thresholds.

safetyAndCleanup.earlierPlaywrightBrowsers: Each validation invocation used its own Playwright ephemeral profile/context and normally closed context and browser; no shared user browser profile was opened.
